art_direction: 27岁原创女主穿宽肩蓝色西装和长裤，在明亮街景大步向前。
composition_variation: Design an original 27-year-old anime woman with a sleek platinum-blonde bob, captured taking a bold natural walking step along a quiet modern plaza. She wears an opaque electric-blue oversized blazer over a high-neck black top and matching full-length trousers, with simple sneakers. Use high-contrast fashion illustration, lemon-yellow architectural accents, crisp noon shadows, and a lively raised-chin smile. Keep the composition dynamic through fabric movement and perspective alone. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
